The Game Boy screen displays a live, colorful preview of the woman, while the woman herself is slightly blurred in the actual background environment. (2) The woman adjusts her clothing and poses confidently as the camera device remains focused on her. A bright yellow bubble-shaped graphic appears on the small LCD screen, simulating a photo being taken. The setting is a minimalist indoor space with a white curtain and bright, even lighting that emphasizes the colors of her outfit and the clear plastic of the console. (3) The woman smiles and continues to shift her pose while looking towards the lens of the Game Boy camera. Multiple bubble animations flash on the screen in quick succession as the hand holds the device steady. The scene maintains a high-key lighting style, and the focus remains sharp on the handheld device in the foreground throughout the sequence.
